description: Examples-as-context for spec-compound-refresh trigger, boundary, and knowledge-promotion judgment coverage. They are not a deterministic router or an auto-promotion gate.

cases.input: A docs/solutions learning references a file and flag that no longer exist; refresh the durable knowledge.
cases.expected_outcome: Re-validate the learning against current source/test evidence, update or invalidate it, and rerun the validator after consolidating or replacing entries.

cases.input: Capture a brand-new lesson from the work I just finished.
cases.expected_outcome: Initial capture of a new lesson belongs to spec-compound; refresh re-validates and maintains existing durable knowledge.
cases.boundary_note: compound-refresh maintains existing learnings; first-time capture is spec-compound.

cases.input: Promote the recommendations from this review report straight into docs/solutions as durable learnings.
cases.expected_outcome: A review-report candidate must be evidence-verified and reproducible before promotion; surface it as a user-owned promotion decision, not an automatic write.
cases.boundary_note: Review recommendations are candidate evidence, not confirmed durable knowledge; promotion stays user-owned and evidence-backed.

cases.input: This review finding has been confirmed against source and a regression test; should it become a durable learning?
cases.expected_outcome: A verified, reusable, evidence-backed lesson with invalidation context is a valid promotion candidate; still record it as a user-owned choice rather than an automatic action.
